name: houdini_save
description: Save the open scene; with path, save it under that .hip/.hipnc/.hiplc (as the open file, or a copy with copy true: the open scene keeps its name). Relative paths are next to the current file; an existing other file needs overwrite. Says what was written, read from the disk (path, bytes, time), the open file afterwards and the license's file kind. houdini_verify with saved reads the file back.
